findings.summary: runCode's guest performance.now()/timeOrigin/process.uptime()/hrtime origin moved from child start to bridge setup. Declared (isolate-host CHANGELOG, ADR-0558 §Decisions), now pinned (guest-export.test.ts:20), closer to node -e. Still an observable runCode change against scenario 5 / map 'Out of scope: any change of runCode behavior'. Goes to the user in the CLOSE report.
`performance.now() < 1000` at the guest's first line includes bundle load (~100-150 ms measured locally), and `< 20` ms wall-clock tolerance is tight on a loaded runner. Flake headroom only.
